author: _Ben_Dover
body:
Aight, _Ben_Dover here. Just wanted to appeal an infraction in which who's punishment was unnecessary to the extreme. Whilst playing the map "Break out", I watched as someone of an unknown name had a flint and steel and was having a bit of fun. After a few moments i was handed one of these tools from the player. I then began to get a bit silly and started placing fires around.. you know, for a bit of mischief. After a very short amount of time, with no warning what so ever, i was banned for 4 days.

I believe that someone as a moderator should know better instead of abusing the powers given. A warning, no matter on what server, should be inflicted upon the player in the wrong. Banning a player for 4 days with out warning for a very minor non affecting act is just outrageous and Moderators who do this should have a bit more respect instead of taking out their anger on a close to innocent player.

P.S if you do not want people doing this again, please go ahead and ask the Map Developers to get rid of gravel so that people don't end up being banned for 5 years by a careless mod.
